messages.author: 63f588d09f2947ce
messages.subject: Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
parts:
Hi
I have recently downloaded R version  2.15.2.  I also downloaded your new update package.  However, when I use the extractModelSummaries code I get this error:
Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
  First line not dividing into LHS and RHS:    lrtstarts 0 0 100 25

Is there are way around this error?  the extract model summaries code works fine on my data with R Version 2.14.0

Kind regards

Frances

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
parts:
Hi Frances,

Can you post (or privately message me if you do not want it public)
your output file? In particular, I wonder if you do not have:

lrtstarts = 0 0 100 25

because the package parses left and right hand side by the Mplus
keywords ARE/IS/=, so I would understand that warning if you did not
have any equals sign.

Anyway, if you can send the .out file that would be tremendously
helpful --- it is much easier to help and provide assistance with an
example to work off of :)

Cheers,

Josh

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
parts:
Hi Frances,

Glad to hear it. I think that Mplus is pretty lax about not requiring
ARE/IS/=, but that is how the MplusAutomation package knows the
section versus input. Unforunately, Mplus does not return output in a
single structured form, so to get it into R, we must parse the text
file based on certain rules, such as commands to the left of certain
delimitters, variables, input, etc. on the right.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
parts:
Hi all,

I have refactored the divideIntoFields code to be tolerant of not using IS/ARE/=. I think this change will fix any of the related issues that have come up. The change is committed to Github, so you can obtain the fix using:

install.packages("devtools")
require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")

Let me know if you have any further problems with divideIntoFields.

Best,
Michael
